QuestInfo.name: Grandma Yeon's Pot
QuestInfo.0: Word is that Grandma Yeon of the Folk Town is great at making pots.
QuestInfo.1: I needed a new pot for Kong Ji, so I went to see Grandma Yeon near the water mill. She seemed very appreciative of the fact that I helped her husband get something done in the past, and decided to sell it to me cheap. #b5,000 mesos#k? Is that really considered cheap?
QuestInfo.2: I was able to purchase Grandma Yeon's pot for 5,000 mesos.

0.0: 아이고~ 오랫만이에요. 그 동안 잘 지냈수? \r\n#L0# 항아리를 사러왔어요.
0.1: 항아리 말이우? 간혹 사람들이 내 항아리를 사러 오긴하지. 내 특별히 싸게 드리리다.

yes.0: 5000메소만 내면 새 항아리를 드리리다. 돈이 준비되면 나에게 다시 말을 걸어요.

no.0: 마음이 바뀐거요? 다시 항아리가 필요하게 되면 찾아와요. 당신한테라면 언제든지 항아리를 팔테니

0.0: Hello, it's been a long time. How have you been? \r\n#L0# #bI'm here to buy your pot.#k
0.1: Are you talking about pots? Well, people do come here every now and then for pots. I'll make it especially cheap for you.

yes.0: For #b5,000 mesos#k, I'll make a new pot for you. Let me know when you're ready with the money.

no.0: Have you changed your mind? If you need a pot down the road, let me know. You'll always be welcome here.

1.0: I'll give you the finest pot I've ever made here, I promise. Okay, this one looks really nice...
